The path and the timing transferred, but the grip didn't. The person takes the jar with five fingers and the palm, while Ada has two fingers that spread 9 cm apart. The distance between the thumb and the index finger here is 15 cm, and the robot can't carry out such a command. That's why Physical Intelligence doesn't take the gripper opening from human video at all and learns it from robot data, while HAT and EgoScale put multi-fingered hands on their robots and transfer the human finger movements onto them.
